name: gmti-wide-area
label: Wide-area GMTI (generic)
description: Airborne ground moving target indicator in wide-area surveillance: dwells revisit the same ground every few seconds to tens of seconds, and plots are noisy. A balance between keeping real traffic and holding back clutter.
basis: Benchmark and the GMTI tests: at clutter density 2e-7 the Garden Island recordings (13 and 14 Oct 2015, very noisy) give 72 and 30 system tracks (2.4 and 5.9 live) where 3e-8 gave about 1,150 and 220, and the Stuart Highway recording (real road traffic, 12.8 s revisit) keeps 8 tracks, 5 of them 30 s or longer. Stricter (1e-6, gmti-high-clutter) holds Garden Island to 17 tracks but loses every Stuart Highway track. GNN, auto timing.
